The Integration Pitch

Why Vorro, why now

Oregon Specialty Group supports four distinct specialty practices, oncology, rheumatology, infectious disease and specialty infusion, each with its own scheduling, EHR and billing setup even while sharing back-office services.

Even where each practice's own systems look tidy on paper, Vorro's job is making sure every one of them agrees on the same patient and revenue record.

The payoff is concrete: one integration layer retires the redundant interfaces and manual data movement that quietly drain the budget, streamlining operations and taking roughly 35% out of what a multi-practice specialty group OSG's size spends on technology.
